name: Onodera Sayaka
source:
As she is kind of a star, she often has to miss class.
Even though she would rather enjoy her time with her classmates, her parents are making her focus on work instead.
She's quite chatty, so much so that she can be hard to talk to.

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
